title: The Girl at the Crosswalk Glitch

dialogue.text: The first morning of the new school term -- and Aoi is already running late.
No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: The traffic light at the corner flickers between red and green so fast it becomes a pale white pulse.
Aoi skids to a stop, one shoe half-on, school bag bouncing against her side.
It was just a shortcut... why is the road... doing that?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: The air above the crosswalk bends like heat haze.
Something small and metallic lies in the middle of the white stripes, blinking with a blue light.
Did someone drop... a phone?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: A sound answers her: not a ring, but a thin chiming note, like glass singing underwater.
The world skips.
For one breath, every passing car is gone.
In the empty street stands a girl in the same school uniform, silver-haired, looking up at the wires overhead as if she has never seen a sky crowded with them.
Temporal anchor unstable. Native witness present.
dialogue.speaker: Girl

dialogue.text: U-um. Are you... talking to me?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: The girl lowers her gaze. Her eyes catch the morning light wrong, bright like the inside of a screen.
Yes. Please do not step on the device.
dialogue.speaker: Girl

dialogue.text: I wasn't going to.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: Her voice comes out smaller than she means it to.
Then the world snaps back.
Cars roar past again. A cyclist yells. The silver-haired girl is suddenly right beside the crosswalk pole, as if she had always been there.
Young lady, if you're crossing, cross. Don't freeze in the road.
dialogue.speaker: Old Woman

dialogue.text: S-sorry!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: Heat climbs to Aoi's face.
She darts forward, snatches up the blinking scrap of metal, and jumps back to the sidewalk.
Thank you. That object maintains my local consistency.
dialogue.speaker: Girl

dialogue.text: Your... what?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: The reason I remain shaped like a transfer student and not a statistical accident.
dialogue.speaker: Girl

dialogue.text: Aoi stares at the piece in her palm.
It is lighter than paper and warmer than skin. Tiny symbols crawl across its surface, vanishing when she tries to focus on them.
This isn't a phone.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: No.
dialogue.speaker: Girl

dialogue.text: And you're not a transfer student.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: Not exactly.
dialogue.speaker: Girl

dialogue.text: Aoi's heart kicks hard enough to hurt.
She should run. She should call someone. She should absolutely not be standing here having this conversation on the first day of term.
I... should be at school.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: I know. Your train was delayed three minutes because I arrived inside its timetable.
dialogue.speaker: Girl

dialogue.text: That was because of you?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: Yes. I regret the inconvenience.
dialogue.speaker: Girl

dialogue.text: Something in the girl's flat, careful tone almost makes Aoi laugh.
The fear loosens by a thread.
You sound like an apology email.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: The silver-haired girl blinks once, then tilts her head.
Is that favorable?
dialogue.speaker: Girl

dialogue.text: ...Not really.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: neutral

dialogue.text: For the first time, the girl's mouth lifts. It's tiny, uncertain, but real.
Then I will improve.
dialogue.speaker: Girl

dialogue.text: A bell rings faintly from the school grounds in the distance.
Aoi's stomach drops.
No... homeroom.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: If you return the anchor, I can correct a small error.
dialogue.speaker: Girl

dialogue.text: A small error?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: The girl extends her hand.
Blue light slips between her fingers, and for an instant the crosswalk lines stretch into stars.
Three minutes. No more. Time dislikes being folded twice.
dialogue.speaker: Girl

dialogue.text: Aoi swallows, then places the impossible device in her palm.
If this makes me later, I'm blaming you forever.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: The girl closes her hand.
The morning lurches softly, like an elevator stopping.
Aoi is suddenly at the school gate, cherry trees trembling overhead, breath still caught in her throat.
You are on time now.
dialogue.speaker: Girl

dialogue.text: She stands beside Aoi as if she belongs there, uniform neat, expression composed.
You're coming in too?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: I require camouflage.
dialogue.speaker: Girl

dialogue.text: That's a terrible way to say 'school life.'
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: Aoi presses a hand to her chest, feeling her heartbeat slowly settle.
Then, despite everything, a shy smile touches her lips.
Then... try not to break reality before lunch, okay?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness
